name: long_march_5b upper_bare
note: Launch vehicle render model (tools/make_rocket_models.py), long_march_5b: upper_bare. Body frame: +Z toward the nose, origin at the aft end; engine bells below it. Booster nose cone length estimated. Shown after fairing separation.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: +Z along the thrust axis (the sim passes it as 'velocity'), -Y (the ship's heat shield) down
sources.source: A rocket flies along its thrust axis; a gravity turn and an entry fly belly down.

sources.value: diameters and lengths rounded from the references; shapes (ogives, flaps, tapers) estimated from photographs
sources.source: Wikipedia 'Long March 5': 5 m core (2 YF-77), four 3.35 m boosters (2 YF-100 each) 27.6 m, 5B: no second stage, 5.2 m x 20.5 m fairing, 53.7 m

sources.value: white: white paint (operator liveries in launch photographs); black: black paint / carbon composite (interstages, legs); grey: grey paint (Soyuz, Long March detail)
sources.source: Liveries from photographs; reflectance from the presets.
